director_disposition: CYCLE 8 COMPLETE — 11 benchmarks (9 previous + 2 new: TF metadata human-indexing, adversarial falsification). Adversarial testing reveals: (1) baseline FALSIFIED by language dominance 0.982 > 0.9, (2) both representations FALSIFIED by dead zones (20 pairs sim>0.95 across branches), (3) debiasing reduces language dominance 0.982→0.818 but doesn't eliminate dead zones, (4) similarity distribution is compressed (90% between 0.82-0.95). TF metadata benchmark shows representations strongly recover court structure (branch k-NN 0.967, chamber 0.927, legal-area 0.418). Next: test citation-graph representations against adversarial benchmarks, add temporal stability test.
